digest.component_or_area: AC verifier completion recovery and budgeting
propositions: Primary AC verifier runs bank criterion verdicts incrementally via a new record_criterion_verdict tool and resume unverified criteria in batched successor runs under a request budget pool, eliminating the per-criterion fan-out that was 1.8x the primary budget.

Criterion identity is deterministic (c<index>-<sha256>) and persistent across runs; the run-scoped bank (.rebar/workflow_runs/<run_id>/bank/) stamps ticket/material/tree provenance; successors preflight stamps and fail loud on mismatch.

Pool arithmetic is criteria-scaled: N = ceil(verify_step_floor(c) / 2) where verify_step_floor(c) = clamp(8*c, 48, 480); global pool = 1.5 * N; successors share per-run floor(pool_remaining / runs_remaining) with batch-aware launch guard and shrink re-planning.

Finalizer always emits full-coverage verdict from banked evidence (verified criteria scored, unverified as met=false placeholders); deterministic no-LLM fallback on repeated finalizer failure emits from bank with certifiable=false, closing the verdict-less trap.

Lever 1 (criteria-scaled primary floor) replaces flat 480 steps with verify_step_floor(c), reducing overbudgeting of small-criteria tickets and lowering runaway-guard trips; Lever 2 (path-normalized read_file memo) caches whole-file content once and slices all ranges from cache, collapsing 77% re-read waste.

Zero-progress successor stops recovery; coverage merge validates banked-union-successor set by criterion ID order-insensitive; per-entry evidence capped at 3000 chars with truncated flag; cache_settings_for automatic prompt cache (system+tools+message-tail) reused across primary-successor.
